bank_transfer.heading: Payment details
bank_transfer.qr_hint: Or scan the QR code in your banking app:
campaign.reason: You receive this email because you subscribed to news from {shop}.
credit_note.heading: Credit note {doc}
credit_note.intro: {shop} has issued a credit note for order {number}; it is attached as a PDF.
credit_note.subject: Credit note for order {number}
footer: This email was sent to you by {shop}.
invoice.heading: Invoice {doc}
invoice.intro: Thank you for shopping at {shop}. The invoice for order {number} is attached as a PDF.
invoice.subject: Invoice for order {number}
magic_link.expiry: The link is valid for {minutes} minutes and works once.
magic_link.heading: Sign in to your account
magic_link.ignore: If you did not ask to sign in, ignore this email.
magic_link.intro: Use the button to sign in to your account at {shop}.
magic_link.subject: Sign in to {shop}
newsletter_confirm.expiry: The link is valid for {hours} hours.
newsletter_confirm.heading: Please confirm your subscription
newsletter_confirm.ignore: If you did not sign up, ignore this email. We will not send you anything.
newsletter_confirm.intro: Thanks for signing up for news from {shop}. Your subscription starts once you confirm it.
newsletter_confirm.subject: Confirm your {shop} newsletter subscription
order.heading: Order {number}
order.subject: Order {number}
order_cancelled.heading: Order {number} was cancelled
order_cancelled.intro_expired: We did not receive the payment for your order at {shop} in time, so the order was cancelled. If you still want the goods, please place a new order.
order_cancelled.intro_merchant: {shop} has cancelled your order. If you have any questions, just reply to this email.
order_cancelled.refund: Everything you paid is being refunded; you will receive a separate confirmation.
order_cancelled.subject: Order {number} was cancelled
order_confirmation.bank_transfer: You will find the payment details on the order page.
order_confirmation.cod: You pay when you collect the parcel.
order_confirmation.intro: Thank you for shopping at {shop}. We have received your order; here is a summary.
order_confirmation.prepaid: The order page shows the payment status.
order_confirmation.subject: Order confirmation {number}
order_delivered.heading: Order {number} was delivered
order_delivered.intro: Your order from {shop} has been delivered. We hope you enjoy it.
order_delivered.subject: Order {number} was delivered
order_delivered.withdrawal: You may withdraw from the purchase within 14 days of delivery without giving a reason.
order_refunded.heading: Refund for order {number}
order_refunded.method_bank: The money is sent to account {iban}.
order_refunded.method_card: The money goes back to the card you paid with; banks usually show it within a few days.
order_refunded.method_other: The shop will return the money by the same means you paid.
order_refunded.subject: Refund for order {number}
order_shipped.heading: Order {number} is on its way
order_shipped.intro: Good news from {shop}: we handed your parcel to {carrier}.
order_shipped.subject: Your order {number} is on its way
password_changed.heading: Your password was changed
password_changed.intro: The password of your account at {shop} was just set or changed. Other signed-in devices were signed out.
password_changed.not_you: If this was not you, sign in with an email link and change the password right away.
password_changed.subject: Your {shop} password was changed
payment_reminder.cancel_note: Unpaid orders are cancelled when the payment period ends.
payment_reminder.heading: We are waiting for the payment of order {number}
payment_reminder.intro: Your order at {shop} is still unpaid. If you have already paid, please ignore this email.
payment_reminder.subject: Payment reminder for order {number}
staff_invite.expiry: The link is valid for {minutes} minutes. Ask for a new invitation when it expires.
staff_invite.heading: Invitation to manage {shop}
staff_invite.intro: You were invited to help run {shop}. The button signs you in to the admin.
staff_invite.subject: Invitation to manage {shop}
withdrawal_link.expiry: The link is valid for {hours} hours and works once.
withdrawal_link.heading: Confirm your withdrawal
withdrawal_link.ignore: If you did not ask for it, ignore this email: nothing changes.
withdrawal_link.intro: Someone asked to withdraw from order {number} at {shop}. Open the link to choose the items and confirm the withdrawal.
withdrawal_link.subject: Confirm your withdrawal - {shop}
withdrawal_receipt.heading: We received your withdrawal from order {number}
withdrawal_receipt.intro: {shop} received your withdrawal on {declared_at}. This is your confirmation; the full declaration follows.
withdrawal_receipt.keep: Keep this email as proof of your withdrawal.
withdrawal_receipt.next: Please send the goods back to the shop. We will refund you no later than {refund_due}, once we receive the goods or proof that you sent them.
withdrawal_receipt.subject: Withdrawal from order {number} received
